title: IronWit
description: Giving nitwit villagers a purpose by letting them drop iron in hoppers.
body:
![Text formatted in three rows like a Minecraft update title: (row 1, tilted back, iron block) Iron, (row 2, tilted forward, minecraft cake) Wit, (row 3, small text, purplish text on dark background) Giving Nitwits a Purpose.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2dac8f342081a73f007dcfbb99eaa7b8f0873895.png)
**Updated 21 June 2025. Works with 1.21.6; should work with all 1.21.x, but not guaranteed.**

If specific versions are needed, please join the Discord and ask in the data-pack-suggestions forum.
# Purpose
Villager nitwits currently have little purpose in-game. This data pack remedies that by making them a sustainable source of iron.

# Directions for Use
1. Install data pack.
2. Get a nitwit to stand over a hopper.

# Notes
Nitwits must be between 0 and 0.5 blocks above a hopper to drop iron. All nitwits over hoppers will drop iron at the same time.

# Known Issues
- None known.
